title: Kryeit++
description: The modpack for Kryeit Survival SMP, with added utilities, performance, and optional shaders added.
body:
Kryeit + Better Performance,
Kryeit + More QoL Features,
## Kryeit++

For the Kryeit survival SMP!
Mine, craft and create!

> Technical minecraft, yet a relaxed environment to play on.
> You can find here a long-term mindset, a friendly community and a lot of moss.
```
- MuriPlz (I think)
```

https://kryeit.com/

![Anchorage post, Kryeit (BSL Classic Shaders)](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9fe997a1fe517943219a8564ffc8e2776a745b7.jpeg)
## Contents
- Base modpack:
  - Create (Deco, Delightful creators, Crafts & Additions, Steam & Rails, etc...)
  - Farmers delight
  - Building mods (Chimes, Connectible chains, etc...)
- Optimisations:
  - Sodium
  - Iris
  - Ferrite Core
  - And more!
- Utils:
  - Xaero's world/minimap
  - ContainerSearcher
  - Resourcify (Automatic resource/shaderpack/etc... downloader)
  - Fullbright
  - Do a barrell roll/ElytraHud
  - Pickup notifier
  - Jade
  - Controlling
  - And more!
- Shaders:
  - BSL Classic (Optimised by me, recommended for performance)
  - Photon
  - Complimentary
